$comment: World place names, first release: eight cultures, each building names in its own way and writing them in modern English. Template syntax: {list} draws a word, {list:pl} its plural, {list:pos} its possessive, {#source} a new proper name from a Markov corpus, + between parts marks a fusable compound. List entries may hold their own templates. 'Word|plural' gives an irregular plural; a trailing ~ marks a word that never fuses. Data only.

cultures.label: Anglo-Saxon
cultures.guide: Fused compounds, specific first and generic last: the baseline for every other set.

eras.label: Old English
eras.guide: Fords, farms and clearings; owners' names; a few old gods.

eras.label: Modern
eras.guide: Old cores with new tags: junctions, spas, seaside towns, estates and aspirations.

cultures.label: Norse
cultures.guide: Owners' farms, god-shrines and blunt landscape words: dale, fell, ness, holm.

cultures.label: Celtic
cultures.guide: Head-first naming in the saints' era: Mouth of, Church of, Fort of, Head of.

eras.label: Pagan
eras.guide: Forts, plains and sacred groves of the old gods.

eras.label: Saints
eras.guide: Churches and cells of the saints, river mouths, forts and headlands.

cultures.label: Roman / Italian
cultures.guide: Imperial: gods and emperors as founders, forums, milestones. Medieval: saints, castles, towers and boroughs.

eras.label: Imperial
eras.guide: Shrines, harbours and waters of the gods; forums and colonies of great men.
templates: Colony of {emperor} at the Altar of {god}

eras.label: Medieval
eras.guide: Saints and castles; towers, rocks and boroughs; new villages on the hills.

cultures.label: Chinese
cultures.guide: Places named by position (north of the river, sunny bank), and in imperial times by slogan and virtue.

eras.label: Imperial
eras.guide: Capitals by direction, cities named for peace and virtue, frontier towns named as orders.

eras.label: Modern
eras.guide: Positional names, plain descriptions of islands, harbours and fords, and socialist slogans.

cultures.label: Egyptian
cultures.guide: Animal gods and theology: houses, horizons and seats of the gods; under the Greeks, cities of gods and beasts.

eras.label: Pharaonic
eras.guide: House of Bastet, Horizon of the Aten, Enduring and Beautiful, the White Walls.

eras.label: Graeco-Roman
eras.guide: City of Zeus, City of the Crocodiles, Ptolemy's City, Mouse Harbour.

cultures.label: Aztec
cultures.guide: Locative compounds: place of deer, grasshopper hill, near the trees. Colonial: saints joined to native names.

eras.label: Mexica
eras.guide: Place of coyotes, grasshopper hill, where flowers abound, Tlaloc's mountain.

eras.label: Colonial
eras.guide: Saint plus native name, Our Lady, royal mines, missions and new homelands.

cultures.label: Bantu
cultures.guide: One invented people-name per batch feeds land, place and royal-town names, so a batch reads as one region.

cultures.label: Slavic
cultures.guide: Bare possessives and new towns; then tsars' glory and 'Ruler of the East'; then waves of Soviet renaming.

eras.label: Rus'
eras.guide: New Town, Yaroslav's, Pitch Town, Pereslavl beyond the Woods.

eras.label: Imperial
eras.guide: Tsars' and empresses' towns, 'Glory of Catherine', 'Ruler of the East' on the frontier.

eras.label: Soviet
eras.guide: Red Gift, Young Communists' Town, October Town, Electric Steel, closed towns known only by number.

cultures.label: Arabic & Persian
cultures.guide: Abode of Peace, Mother of Palaces, Gate of Lamentation, Tariq's Mountain; Persian abodes, gardens and kings' glory.

eras.label: Arabic
eras.guide: Abodes and cities of peace, mothers and fathers of things, weekday markets, the Victorious.

eras.label: Persian
eras.guide: Pleasant Abode, Shapur's City, Glory of Ardashir, Land of Roses, Seven Springs.

cultures.label: Indian
cultures.guide: Ancient: gods' cities and plains, sacred confluences, the Unconquerable. Modern: founders' abodes and cities, forts, markets, cantonments.

eras.label: Ancient
eras.guide: Indra's Plain, City of Elephants, Between the Varuna and the Asi, the Many-Gated.

eras.label: Modern
eras.guide: Ahmad's Abode, Jai's City, Fort of Chandi, the River Market, McLeod's Market, Cantonment.

cultures.label: Japanese
cultures.guide: Modifier first and generic last, close to English: Long Cape, River Mouth. Samurai era adds auspicious pairs and castle towns; modern adds suburban hills of hope.

eras.label: Samurai
eras.guide: Fortune Hill, Below the Castle, New Lodging, Capital of Peace and Tranquillity, Before Hachiman's Gate.

eras.label: Modern
eras.guide: The old patterns plus suburban dreams: Hope Hill, Cherry Hill, Harbour Future, Station Front, New Town.

cultures.label: West African
cultures.guide: Under the Kum Tree, Crocodile River, Buktu's Well, Grove of Osun; towns of invented peoples, a batch at a time.

cultures.label: Maya
cultures.guide: Big Water, Mouth of the Well of the Itza, Snake Kingdom, Three Stones; colours that are also directions.

eras.label: Classic
templates: Mouth of the Well of the {people}

cultures.label: Korean
cultures.guide: Big Hill, Cauldron Mountain, Water Source; district names of virtue, and provinces that blend two districts.

cultures.label: Ethiopian
cultures.guide: Mount of Light, Mount of Mark, New Flower, Hot Spring; royal camps and churches cut from the rock.
